definitions.gelu: z * Phi(z), exact erf implementation, approximate=none
definitions.swiglu_tied: SiLU(z) * z; gate and value projections both equal the frozen W_in. Both branches are co-perturbed. This is an explicit tied-projection special case, not a checkpoint trained with general SwiGLU.

intervention: Replace the scalar nonlinearity only, with all encoder/decoder weights frozen. Reuse exact parent pairs, codeword/random directions, backgrounds, anchor values, signs, grids and thresholds. No per-activation reselection, calibration, weight scaling or fitting.
task_fidelity: Re-evaluate the same clean sample and single-feature probes against the original target ReLU(x). Save all gains and eligibility after each swap; retain original selected pairs even if their task fidelity declines.
primary_response: L2 to each activation variant's own clean anchor output; parent threshold rule recalibrates per surface and fraction.
baseline: Read all frozen ReLU arrays from parent; independently recompute sampled ReLU grids and task metrics for parity.
fine_checks: First frozen pair, inactive and negative anchor states, ++ sign, both direction kinds, each model, 81x81. All four activations. This adds the negative-anchor baseline check to the parent fine checks.
corruption: Same 4096 clean samples, Gaussian noise draws/norms and five noise levels as parent; natural activation only for each swap, target remains ReLU(clean x). Gaussian noise distribution is unchanged.
analysis: Original additive superellipse and PSD tilted-quadratic fits, three thresholds and per-background sensitivity. Retain flat, poor-fit and nonmonotone cases. Report same original feature cohorts and post-swap eligibility.
interpretation: Frozen-weight nonlinear intervention and independent-coordinate control. No models are retrained; results do not measure grokking or establish what separately trained GELU/SiLU/full-SwiGLU models would learn.
stopping_rule: Three activation swaps on all parent surfaces, fixed task/noise checks, and prespecified fine grids. No training, activation-parameter search, extra model families, or remote publication.
